## BigDecimal

9-digit operands, precision 28. libmpdec is the C library behind
CPython's `decimal`, timed without the interpreter.

| Operation | decimo | libmpdec | vs libmpdec | CPython `decimal` | vs CPython |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| add | 43.8 ns | 42.0 ns | parity | 48.1 ns | **1.10× faster** |
| subtract | 45.4 ns | 36.3 ns | 1.25× slower | 50.8 ns | **1.12× faster** |
| multiply | 40.4 ns | 27.6 ns | 1.46× slower | 43.8 ns | **1.09× faster** |
| divide | 144.8 ns | 48.5 ns | 2.99× slower | 65.5 ns | 2.21× slower |
| round | 43.0 ns | 35.7 ns | 1.20× slower | 75.1 ns | **1.75× faster** |
| parse | 95.5 ns | 41.6 ns | 2.30× slower | 80.4 ns | 1.19× slower |

In place, where neither side allocates a result:

| | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x += y` | 6.4 ns | 8.1 ns | **1.26× faster** |
| `x -= y` | 42.4 ns | 8.2 ns | 5.18× slower |
| `x *= y` | 51.2 ns | 21.5 ns | 2.38× slower |

## BigDecimal across operand sizes

decimo's time, and how it compares with libmpdec at that size.

| Digits | add | | multiply | | divide | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9 | 35.2 ns | 1.16× slower | 39.8 ns | 1.36× slower | 133.2 ns | 2.89× slower |
| 100 | 45.1 ns | **1.22× faster** | 108.9 ns | **1.30× faster** | 1.27 µs | 3.63× slower |
| 1,000 | 108.5 ns | 1.05× slower | 2.49 µs | **3.55× faster** | 26.52 µs | 1.86× slower |
| 10,000 | 810.0 ns | 1.25× slower | 123.22 µs | **2.89× faster** | 526.17 µs | **2.44× faster** |
| 100,000 | 7.55 µs | 1.15× slower | 4.19 ms | 1.50× slower | 15.49 ms | 1.14× slower |

## BigInt against CPython's int

CPython's integers can only be reached through the interpreter, so
these include its overhead — read the large sizes as the real ones.

| Digits | decimo add | CPython add | | decimo multiply | CPython multiply | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 39.2 ns | 23.9 ns | 1.64× slower | 81.3 ns | 93.2 ns | **1.15× faster** |
| 1,000 | 51.2 ns | 84.2 ns | **1.64× faster** | 1.10 µs | 5.20 µs | **4.72× faster** |
| 10,000 | 268.0 ns | 766.8 ns | **2.86× faster** | 50.72 µs | 252.51 µs | **4.98× faster** |
| 100,000 | 2.36 µs | 7.65 µs | **3.24× faster** | 1.13 ms | 8.24 ms | **7.26× faster** |

## pi()

Each measurement in a fresh process, since mpmath and MPFR cache the
constant. Includes conversion to a decimal string, for every library.

| Digits | decimo | mpmath + GMP | MPFR | mpmath (pure Python) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 7.42 µs | 48.38 µs | 45.33 µs | 33.17 µs |
| 1,000 | 66.96 µs | 107.12 µs | 70.71 µs | 156.42 µs |
| 10,000 | 1.22 ms | 792.38 µs | 666.58 µs | 5.72 ms |
| 100,000 | 33.33 ms | 14.44 ms | 22.88 ms | 174.59 ms |
| 1,000,000 | 784.74 ms | 269.98 ms | 404.87 ms | 8.196 s |
